text: Kyiv, Voskresenka. New groups are arriving more often. Helicopters are leaving shorter gaps between launches.
He is watching the horizon on his own now. I think he can tell the engines apart, too.
There is no dragon. This is mass panic. We advise pilots not to look up without permission from their commanding officer.
Yesterday he was the spare. Today he does not exist. I really must keep up with your broadcasts.
Better keep up with the missiles. Voskresenka is below us.
